core_obligations: Set up: endow each space with its constructible topology and note that the transition maps are continuous there (proof lines 5008-5015)

Constructible limit is quasi-compact: the restrictions to the closed subsets form an inverse system of quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces, so their limit is quasi-compact by the space-level statement (proof lines 5016-5018)
Transfer: the map from the constructible limit to the limit is continuous and bijective on underlying sets, so the limit is quasi-compact as its image (proof lines 5019-5023)
proof_roadmap: 把每个 X_i 换成可构造拓扑 X'_i、Z_i 换成相应的（在可构造拓扑中闭的）子空间 Z'_i；谱映射在该拓扑下连续。
各 Z'_i 是准紧 Hausdorff，转移映射连续 ⇒ 由「逆极限准紧」得 Z' = lim Z_i 准紧。
Z'_i → Z_i 连续 ⇒ Z' → Z 连续且是底层点集上的双射 ⇒ Z 作为满连续像准紧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a limit of constructibly closed subsets of spectral spaces compatible with spectral transition maps is quasi-compact, and hence that the limit of the spectral spaces themselves is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 4995-5006, label lemma-inverse-limit-spectral-spaces-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 5008-5024) passes to the constructible topologies where the restricted system consists of quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces, applies the space-level quasi-compactness of limits and transfers the conclusion along the continuous bijection (proof lines 5008-5023). The change of topology and the transfer are the substance. H3.
